SecurityPolicy.name: Zero-Trust & Cryptographic Integrity Policy
rules: Mandatory TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256-GCM at rest
RBAC and ABAC dynamic verification on every capability invocation

PrivacyPolicy.name: LGPD & GDPR Compliance Policy
rules: Automatic PII anonymization and tokenization at ingestion boundary
Mandatory audit log for any data access involving personal entities

DeploymentPolicy.name: Autonomous Shadow-First Deployment Policy
rules: Deployments MUST execute first in Shadow Runtime before production promotion
Rollback strategy MUST be verified and pre-computed

QualityPolicy.name: Multidimensional Quality Gate Policy
rules: Minimum overall quality score: 9.0/10 across all 10 quality dimensions
100% automated test coverage for contracts and core domain features

ResearchPolicy.name: Evidence-Backed Decision Policy
rules: No architectural changes without formal Evidence linking (RFC, Paper, Benchmark)
Automated paper & RFC ingestion via Research Engine before design freeze

EvolutionPolicy.name: Continuous Reversible Learning Policy
rules: All mutation results MUST feed back into the Evolution Ledger and Digital Genome
Reversibility matrix MUST be valid for all historical mutations

DocumentationPolicy.name: Living Ontological Documentation Policy
rules: Documentation MUST be auto-generated and synchronized with AST and OpenAPI schemas
Zero undocumented capabilities or features allowed in production

CostPolicy.name: Resource & Token Efficiency Policy
rules: Token budget allocation strictly enforced per intention execution
Resource Orchestrator MUST optimize GPU/CPU/Memory compute utilization
